session_summary: Two rounds of adversarial review against the night's own work, then the fixes. The structural finding: every new guard read public/, which is gitignored and rebuilt on push, and refresh.yml runs selftest FIRST - so in CI they all took their exists() escape and passed. Six mutations to the night's fixes went green. Five guards now build what they check into a temp dir; the badge guard could not, so build_site.attach_active was extracted and is called directly. That extraction immediately opened a smaller hole (main() could stop calling it) which needed its own source-level guard - and that guard did not run for its first minute, because checks here register by a hand-written call line and I wrote the function without it. check_every_check_is_actually_run now compares every def to every call. Separately, the 'boards read this run' card was retired: it added the two coverage buckets CLAUDE.md forbids adding, and 866 of the 1,163 it reported are pages a fetcher cannot enumerate. It is now counted from the run.
